name: openroom

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

description: An open-source investor data room: email sign-in links, folder-by-folder access, stamped documents, view tracking. One click on Cloudflare, or Docker on your own server.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Your email (the one you signed up to Resend with). You sign in with a link sent to it. Add more, separated by commas, for anyone else who manages the room. What you type is hidden because Cloudflare stores it as a secret; that keeps it safe through every update.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Sends the sign-in emails. Make a free account at [resend.com](https://resend.com), then copy a key from **API Keys**. Use the email you signed up to Resend with as your admin email above.
